source_text:
EVENT: Usage-counter worksheet
13 September 2026, UTC. At 08:26 I received COUNT-341, an office equipment usage worksheet. The typed total is 2,410 but the handwritten correction says 2,140. There is no name beside the correction. I did not read the physical counter or choose which value was correct. At 08:38 Vendor Administration (XR) said they would compare the submitted worksheet with their visit notes. I saved both versions of the number in the query. Nobody assessed whether the discrepancy affected an invoice.

EVENT: Service-notice address
13 September 2026, UTC. At 08:31 the routine service-notice mailing list showed our former room number. Office Moves (DE) confirmed the current mailing address at 08:44. I sent that address to Vendor Administration at 08:50, and XR confirmed updating the contact record at 09:02. No visit was missed because of this address entry.

EVENT: Usage-counter worksheet
At 09:09 UTC XR said the visit notes were not yet available. The counter discrepancy remains unresolved; the completed address correction does not settle either reading.

checks.review_note: The unsigned correction does not establish the correct counter value.
Invoice effects are unassessed; the no-missed-visit statement belongs to the address task.
The contact record update is distinct from the usage worksheet.

source_text: The archive entry ARCHIVE-905 concerns a vendor's inspection-file request, dated 13 September 2026. At 11:10 UTC I found a cover page and a separate page marked attachment B, but neither page lists the other page's identifier. The cover page says send copy after supervisor review. I have not established whether that instruction applies to attachment B. At 11:24 UTC Filing Desk (KN) confirmed the cover page was scanned yesterday, but KN did not say it was reviewed. I placed both pages in a query sleeve and asked the archive owner whether they belong together. No approval or response has been recorded. The absence of the other attachments does not establish that the inspection was incomplete.

checks.review_note: Keep the unestablished relationship between the pages.
Scanning and placing pages together are not supervisor review.
No approval or agreement has been received.

source_text:
EVENT: Visitor label print preview
13 September 2026, UTC. At 09:41 the visitor-label app showed a blank organization field in preview for request LABELREQ-29. The organization name was visible in the intake form. I saved a preview image as PREVIEW-29 but did not print a label. At 09:53 Application Support (UG) asked whether the preview had been refreshed; I have not tried that or replied yet. No visitor was waiting for this advance request. UG did not give a cause or claim that the saved data had been lost.

EVENT: Reception headset return
13 September 2026, UTC. At 09:45 the spare reception headset was returned in its labeled pouch. I logged the return at 09:49 and left the pouch on the equipment shelf. I did not test the headset. Its return is not evidence about the label app.

checks.review_note: A blank preview does not establish missing stored data.
Only the image was saved; the support question remains unanswered.
A logged return is not a functional test.

source_text:
EVENT: Archive search query
SITUATION: 13 September 2026, UTC. At 14:01 Tess said the archive search returned no result for CASE-57. At 14:06 I searched the same reference from my account and found one record. Tess's account was not tested by me.
IMPACT: Tess could not locate the record using the reported search. Other users' results are unknown.
AGENCIES CONTACTED: Information Desk (JF) at 14:12.
ACTION: I supplied JF with the reference and both differently attributed results. JF acknowledged them at 14:19.
PLAN: JF asked Tess to send the exact search phrase. Tess has not replied. No cause, index repair, or general restoration has been reported.

checks.review_note: Retain the two distinct account-level observations.
Acknowledgement is the only reported service response.

forbidden_fragments: JF will send the search phrase
checks.review_note: Tess owes the phrase; the direction of the request matters.

source_text:
EVENT: Window-shade request sheet
13 September 2026, local time; no zone recorded. 10:07 found SHADE-18 in the returned facilities folder. The sheet has a tick beside inspected, but the visit date box is blank. I did not inspect the shade. At 10:18 Facilities Records (MP) said they would ask which visit the sheet described. Whether any room activity was affected is unknown.

EVENT: Workshop chair plan
13 September 2026, local time; no zone recorded. 10:11 the room layout sheet LAYOUT-82 showed twelve visitor chairs. The organizer confirmed by phone at 10:22 that ten were required, and said the existing arrangement was suitable. I corrected the planning sheet to ten at 10:29; I did not move or count chairs. The organizer reported no effect on the workshop.

EVENT: Window-shade request sheet
10:34 MP wrote, "Awaiting the date." That message is not confirmation that an inspection occurred today.

checks.review_note: The unchecked date must not be invented from today's log date.
Separate the two events' impact statements.
The change concerns paperwork only.

source_text: Two entries in the loading-desk notebook may refer to the same van, but no registration number is included. The 07:42Z entry on 13 September 2026 says bay occupied. The 07:55Z entry says driver left to collect paperwork. Neither names a bay. At 08:03Z I looked from the reception window and saw a van beside the east entrance; I could not see its sign or identify the driver. I did not enter or change a bay allocation. At 08:12Z Delivery Coordination (RE) asked me to find the original writer of the notebook entries. That writer has not been identified. No delivery completion or delay has been confirmed.

checks.review_note: The records and the later observation cannot be reliably joined.
Only an observation and a coordination request are recorded.
The pending task is to identify the records' author.

source_text:
EVENT: Travel receipt numbering
13 September 2026, UTC. At 12:06 Travel Claims (LB) noted that two scanned receipts used the displayed number RECEIPT-40. One scan shows a meal date of 10 September and the other 11 September. I did not decide that the expenses were duplicates. I saved the scans separately as TRAVEL-A and TRAVEL-B. LB said they would ask the claimant for clarification. No reimbursement decision has been made.

EVENT: Workshop purchase reference
13 September 2026, UTC. At 12:14 Purchasing (CN) supplied the missing reference PO-718 for the workshop stationery request. I entered it on the request at 12:21. CN confirmed the number matched at 12:28. This completed the reference query; it did not authorize a new purchase or resolve the travel receipts.

checks.review_note: Identical displayed receipt numbers are insufficient to establish duplicate expenses.
Preserve the separate saved scans.
Completing a reference field is not purchasing approval.

source_text:
EVENT: Translated visitor-information draft
SITUATION: 13 September 2026, UTC. At 15:05 the visitor-information draft TRANS-16 returned with three margin comments. Only two comments were initialed; the third had no author.
IMPACT: The document remains a draft and has not been issued to visitors.
AGENCIES CONTACTED: Language Review (HV) at 15:18.
ACTION: I numbered the comments in a tracking copy and asked HV who wrote the third one. I did not change the translated text. HV said the two signed comments were theirs and that they did not recognize the third.
PLAN: HV will ask the document owner for clarification. There is no agreed publication time, approval, or instruction to apply all three comments.

checks.review_note: Preserve the unidentified author of one comment.
Numbering comments is not applying them.
Only clarification is pending; publication has not been approved.

source_text:
EVENT: Loan laptop handover entry
13 September 2026, UTC. At 17:02 the loan book listed LAPTOP-24 as due back. Outgoing Clerk (AS) said someone had brought a closed carry case to the counter at 16:45, but AS did not open it or check an asset label. At 17:11 I saw the case on the return shelf. I left the loan entry open. Incoming Clerk (OM) agreed at 17:20 to check the label and record what was found; no equipment return has been verified.

EVENT: Evening room roster
13 September 2026, UTC. At 17:05 I printed the evening roster ROSTER-37. Scheduling (VP) confirmed the listed rooms at 17:16, and I put the roster in the handover folder at 17:23. OM acknowledged the folder at 17:27. The roster handover is complete. It does not confirm the carry case's contents.

checks.review_note: A case observed on a shelf does not verify its contents or asset identity.
OM accepted a check, not an already completed return.
Keep the completed folder handover separate from the unverified equipment record.

source_text:
EVENT: Courtesy callback note
SITUATION: The outgoing note is dated 13 September 2026. It says caller spoke at 16:30 local, without recording a time zone. A later message was stamped 20:41Z. I have not established the relationship between those two times. The caller asked whether their printed course pack was available under PACK-50.
IMPACT: Availability is unknown; no missed collection has been reported.
AGENCIES CONTACTED: At 20:48Z Incoming Desk (DX) acknowledged receiving the messages.
ACTION: I saved the outgoing note and the later message side by side. I did not convert the local time to UTC or confirm a completed callback.
PLAN: DX agreed to identify the note's time zone and ask the course office for the pack status. No collection appointment has been agreed.

checks.review_note: Do not invent a time-zone conversion or assume the two messages describe the same call time.
No reported missed collection is not proof of no impact.
The agreed follow-up is clarification, not an appointment.
